Himachal Pradesh Government Allocates Rs 212 Crore for Medical Reimbursements

The Himachal Pradesh government has released ₹212 crore to settle medical reimbursement claims. This significant allocation aims to address pending claims and provide financial relief to beneficiaries. The move is expected to ease the burden on individuals who have incurred medical expenses.
